{{Quote|It would have been very difficult for the Elder to have sworn before our biological mothers that he would outlive me, since our mothers never met. Mine died in giving birth to me. I was raised in the household of Kuat by the father from whom I received my inheritance.|This woman's son|<ref name="Slave Ship" />}}
The '''mother''' of the [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|died]] giving birth to [[Gender/Legends|him]]. In order to determine that the [[Elder of Knylenn]] was a phony, Kuat claimed that the Elder had sworn to Kuat's mother that the Elder would outlive Kuat, which would be impossible given his mother's death.<ref name="Slave Ship" />
